name: Wuxi DK Electronic Materials Co.,Ltd.
summary: Wuxi DK Electronic Materials Co.,Ltd. operates as a technology-focused enterprise dedicated to the innovation and creation of high-performance materials. The company primarily develops these advanced substances for application within the display and energy industries throughout China. Among its core offerings is a specialized front silver metallization paste, essential for the production of silicon solar cells. The firm's main office and operational base are located in Yixing, China.
